## Summary

What changed and why?

## Change Type

- [ ] Skill behavior or routing
- [ ] Reference or documentation
- [ ] Benchmark or public evidence
- [ ] Installer, release, or repository tooling
- [ ] Fix with no public contract change

## Verification

List the exact checks run and any evidence that remains unavailable.

## Public Assets And Provenance

List every new public image, video, fixture, copied excerpt, or generated asset and its license/provenance. Write `None` when this pull request adds no public assets.

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] The change improves behavior, clarity, or token efficiency.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass, or the reason they cannot run is documented above.
- [ ] The complete installable skill validates and includes its license.
- [ ] Public docs avoid private construction notes.
- [ ] New rules are actionable and non-duplicative.
- [ ] Accessibility, performance, and mobile behavior are not weakened.
- [ ] New or changed parameters, references, and evals remain routed and paired.
- [ ] Release-critical changes include tests and a changelog entry when user-visible.
- [ ] Public screenshots, traces, fixtures, and assets contain no credentials, private URLs, customer data, or unlicensed third-party material.
- [ ] Benchmark changes preserve pinned conditions, failed runs, and raw-result transparency.
- [ ] Every commit in this pull request has an author-matching `Signed-off-by: Name <email>` DCO trailer.
